description.value: Sookjai Thai is a small, intimate Thai restaurant on Fort Street near the corner of Fort and Quadra in Victoria, offering a full dinner menu of classic Thai dishes. The establishment prides itself on a cozy dine-in experience with limited seating, alongside takeout, in-house delivery, and third-party delivery options. They also offer refrigerated ready-to-eat meals and housemade sauces available for grab-and-go during regular hours.

The site explicitly states 'DINE IN, TAKE OUT & IN HOUSE DELIVERY' and lists DoorDash, Uber Eats, and SkipTheDishes, confirming takeout.
